title: OWOB-OHP ENSANUT 2018 reproducibility research compendium
description: R research compendium for selected-sample analyses of nutritional status and reported oral health impacts. WHO 2007 S2 primary exposure; SAV sensitivity. Public reproduction uses frozen aggregates. Full analytical replay requires nonredistributed pivot and certified internal inputs. Unknown F4-to-pivot selection and assumed no oedema; no certified national prevalence claim. D08 pending and submission not authorized. Own code MIT; own documentation and aggregate outputs CC BY 4.0; third-party terms retained.
